title: Bulk subtask creation ergonomics
description: Probes whether the agent discovers vikunja_tasks's bulk-create-subtasks composite (src/tools/tasks/subtasks.ts -- resolves the parent once, then creates+relates every subtask in one call, per-subtask atomic rollback) rather than issuing one create-subtask call per subtask, the way subtask-breakdown.json's smaller (3-subtask) scenario is deliberately left free to do. RE-VERIFIED 2026-07-25 (netadvanced/vikunja-mcp#28 C1): optimalCallCount reasoning unchanged -- create-project (1) + create-task (1, the single parent "Redesign homepage") + bulk-create-subtasks with all 5 subtasks in one call (1) = 3. Neither of the two capabilities that shipped since this was last set (apply-label/remove-label taskIds, PR #178; vikunja_projects setup-kanban, PR #175) reduce this further: there is no label or Kanban-board dimension to this ask, and no tool merges project-creation with subtask-relation-creation.
promptTemplate: Create a project called "{{prefix}}Website Revamp" with one task called "{{prefix}}Redesign homepage". Break that task down into 5 subtasks in a single bulk operation: "{{prefix}}Wireframe", "{{prefix}}Copy draft", "{{prefix}}Visual design", "{{prefix}}Frontend build", and "{{prefix}}QA pass".
